name: menubar
origin: API of shadcn/ui's Menubar (via EMITTE), rebuilt on react-aria Toolbar and the registry's DropdownMenu
description: An app-style menu bar (File, Edit, View…). `Menubar` is a react-aria `Toolbar`, so arrow keys move between menus; each `MenubarMenu` pairs a `MenubarTrigger` with a `MenubarContent` built on `DropdownMenu`, including submenus (`MenubarSub`). Checkbox- and radio-like items come from react-aria selection: give a `MenubarGroup` `selectionMode` ("multiple" or "single") and `selectedKeys`/`onSelectionChange`, and its items show a check when selected. Menus open on press or Enter/Space/ArrowDown.
